text:
anya: quick scan from today's GPTQ bake — uploading a compact snapshot. TL;DR below, react with :eyes: if you want deep dives

sasha: nice, can you share the top-line numbers?

anya: short summary: 
- dataset: truthbench + instr-eval + longformQA (5k examples total)
- configs: fp16 baseline, GPTQ (KN4), AWQ-4bit, INT8 PTQ 
- families: Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, Qwen-7B

Key accuracy deltas (vs fp16) — macro avg across suite: 
- Llama-2-13B GPTQ: -0.6% 
- Llama-2-13B AWQ-4bit: -1.9% 
- Mistral-7B GPTQ: -1.2% (more instruction sensitivity)
- Mistral-7B AWQ-4bit: -2.8% 
- Qwen-7B GPTQ: -0.4% 
- Qwen-7B AWQ-4bit: -1.1% 
- INT8 (PTQ) stable but larger tail regressions: up to -3.5% on longformQA for Mistral (prompt truncation cases)

Performance / latency notes (p50 / p95 single-request on g4dn-equivalent): 
- GPTQ (batched): Llama-2-13B  p50 70ms / p95 210ms  (good throughput, KV cache ok)
- AWQ-4bit: Llama p50 48ms / p95 320ms (low p50, higher p95 due to memcpy spikes)
- Qwen GPTQ: p50 60ms / p95 180ms (best overall balance)

mohit: observed KV cache degradation for GPTQ on long contexts (>= 8k) — per-token time climbs ~1.4x after cache rollover. worth a follow-up.

luke: AWQ's lower p50 is attractive for single-turn UI flows, but the p95 spikes worry me for streaming. could be mitigated with request shaping + small batching.

anya: reproducible commands we used (quick):
```
# convert + eval
python tools/quantize.py --model llama-2-13b --method gptq --bits 4 --out /tmp/llama-13b-gptq
python eval/run_eval.py --model /tmp/llama-13b-gptq --suites truthbench,instr-eval,longformQA --out s3://redwood-quant/bake/3725/llama-13b-gptq.json
```

isabel: suggestion for deployment profile (first pass):
- Llama-2-13B: Dedicated pool, GPTQ, KV cache tuning, reserve burst for longcontext jobs
- Mistral-7B: Hosted with AWQ-4bit for chat-lite; fall back to fp16 or GPTQ for longform jobs
- Qwen-7B: GPTQ preferred for mixed workloads (best accuracy/latency mix)

eval-bot: artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-quant/bake/3725/{llama-13b, mistral-7b, qwen-7b}-results.json; diff reports in /artifacts/diffs/3725/ (baseline fp16 vs quant).

sasha: thanks — can you add the small failure-mode note for Mistral longform (prompt truncation causing INT8 regressions)? want that in the rollout checklist.

anya: added to the checklist + created a short follow-up PR with KV cache test cases. i'll post the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:

mohit: quick FYI — memory profile: GPTQ spikes ~600MB less than fp16 for Llama, AWQ roughly 1.9x smaller than fp16 but CPU memcpy overhead higher.

luke: ok — next steps: (1) isolate Mistral longform failures, (2) run a small canary for AWQ in hosted with request shaping, (3) add KV rollover test to perf-suite. anyone +1?

isabel: +1

sasha: +1

anya: thanks all — tagging follow-ups in GH and will schedule a 15min sync if we hit blockers.
